scope: First private real cutout through reusable, independently reviewed non-lamp Engine-to-QA workflow; not the release ledger, PyPI package, or all-product completion.
counting_rule: Count each named outcome once only when its acceptance is met and linked evidence exists. Local operator-reported execution is labeled separately from public merged code and independent artifact review. Planned and blocked are zero credit. Scope and denominator cannot be silently reset.

milestones.title: Native-1K source created and reviewed
